title: Introducing next-generation audio models in the API
summary: For the first time, developers can also instruct the text-to-speech model to speak in a specific way—for example, “talk like a sympathetic customer service agent”—unlocking a new level of customization for voice agents.
body: For the first time, developers can also instruct the text-to-speech model to speak in a specific way—for example, “talk like a sympathetic customer service agent”—unlocking a new level of customization for voice agents.
summaryZh: OpenAI在API中正式引入了新一代音频模型，开发者首次可以通过指令精准控制文本到语音模型的说话风格，例如模拟同理心客服等特定语气。这一特性大幅提升了语音Agent的定制化水平和自然交互体验，拓展了对话式AI的应用场景。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI在API中引入新一代音频模型并支持语音风格微调，对语音Agent和交互体验有重大影响。
